_readme: Give the AI git tools, with NO MCP server needed.
IMPORTANT - the AI does NOT log in. It cannot: authenticating means handling
your credentials, and an AI reading your token in a chat window is exactly
how tokens leak. YOU authenticate once (see AI-GIT.md), git stores the
credential, and these tools then work because git picks it up.
ZS_WORKSPACE must point at your git repo:
- Every 'run' is an argv LIST executed WITHOUT a shell, so an argument
- There is deliberately NO force-push, NO reset --hard, NO clean, and no
tool that prints credentials or remote URLs (which can embed a token).
- git_push is the only tool that changes anything remote. Delete it if you
want the AI to be able to commit locally but never publish.

target.name: my git repo
target.offline_hint: Point ZS_WORKSPACE at a git repository and restart the bridge.

tools.name: git_status
tools.description: Show which files changed, staged and unstaged, plus the current branch.

tools.name: git_log
tools.description: Show recent commits, most recent first.

tools.name: git_diff
tools.description: Show unstaged changes. Pass staged=--staged to see staged ones instead.

path.description: limit to one file or folder

tools.name: git_show
tools.description: Show one commit in full, including its diff.

tools.name: git_branch
tools.description: List local branches and show which one is checked out.

tools.name: git_add
tools.description: Stage a file or folder for the next commit.

tools.name: git_commit
tools.description: Commit the staged changes with a message. Stage files with git_add first.

tools.name: git_pull
tools.description: Fetch and merge the latest changes from the remote.

tools.name: git_push
tools.description: Publish local commits to the remote. Confirm with the user before using this.

tools.name: git_auth_check
tools.description: Check whether git can authenticate to the remote. Reports the account name only, never the token.
run: if git ls-remote origin >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo 'authenticated: git can reach origin'; else echo 'NOT authenticated (or no origin): see AI-GIT.md to sign in once'; fi
